title: Listing Highlight: 105' Azimut Yachts Grande 105 2012
description: Discover the exquisite 2012 Azimut Grande 105, a luxury motor yacht combining sophisticated design with exceptional performance and comfort.
html:
A Testament to Italian Craftsmanship and Timeless Design

The 2012 Azimut Grande 105 stands as a magnificent testament to Italian yacht building, embodying a perfect fusion of sophisticated design, luxurious comfort, and impressive performance. This motor yacht, spanning 105 feet, offers an unparalleled cruising experience, ideal for those seeking both grand adventures and intimate relaxation on the water. Her design meticulously balances aesthetic appeal with practical functionality, ensuring every journey is a memorable one. Her expansive flybridge is a highlight, designed as a comprehensive outdoor living space. It features a lavish Jacuzzi, spacious sunpads for basking in the sun, a well-appointed wet bar, and ample alfresco dining areas. This upper deck provides breathtaking panoramic views and serves as the primary hub for entertainment and relaxation, seamlessly blending style with leisure. The meticulous attention to detail is evident in every curve and finish, inviting guests to embrace the yachting lifestyle.

Stepping inside, the main salon reveals a world of modern Italian luxury. Plush, comfortable seating arrangements are complemented by large windows that flood the space with natural light and offer uninterrupted ocean vistas. Adjacent to the salon, a formal dining area provides an elegant setting for gourmet meals, perfect for hosting distinguished guests. The interior is characterized by a refined palette and high-quality materials, creating an atmosphere of understated opulence. Accommodation on board is equally impressive, featuring a well-conceived layout that prioritizes privacy and comfort for all guests. The yacht boasts four luxurious cabins, including a magnificent master stateroom, a generous VIP cabin, and two comfortable twin cabins. Each stateroom is accompanied by its own private ensuite bathroom, ensuring a serene and exclusive retreat for everyone on board. The thoughtful arrangement allows for both social gatherings and personal solitude, catering to diverse preferences.

Beneath her graceful exterior, the 2012 Azimut Grande 105 is powered by twin MTU 16V 2000 M93 engines, each delivering 2400 horsepower, allowing for a cruising speed of 22 knots and a thrilling maximum speed of 27 knots. This impressive power is coupled with advanced hydraulic stabilizers, ensuring smooth and comfortable passages even in varying sea conditions. Her planing hull design further contributes to her agility and efficiency on the water, making her a joy to navigate across vast distances. Completing the yacht’s extensive features are a convenient tender garage and a spacious swim platform, enhancing the overall versatility and enjoyment of watersports. This 2012 Azimut Grande 105, currently located in Fort Lauderdale, Florida, represents a prime opportunity for those looking to acquire a vessel that combines prestige with performance.
